This song has a new association for me, now. 

I would play through FFX every few years or so, and on my most recent playthrough, I lost my cat. She went missing and never came back, right towards the end of my most recent playthrough. And not missing as in someone else got her, but missing as in we're pretty certain wild coy dogs got her.

It was a really difficult time, but oddly enough, the themes of the game and the challenges they all deal with helped to ground me and remind myself that death is just a part of life. Everyone in that game lost someone, and they kept going, so it helped remind me that I'd be alright and move on with my grief. 

So, this song made me cry today when listening. I don't know if I'll ever be able to play the game again, because anything in it reminds me of her, but I will always love it and appreciate how it helped me cope with death, even if some people don't consider the death of a beloved pet as significant.

stories.author: @letalleurkevin5133
stories.text:
It was 2001. I was 11 years old. You can't imagine just how mind-blowing that opening scene was. The console gaming market was entering its golden age; competition was fierce, but when SquareSoft released Final Fantasy X, they completely obliterated the competition. A colleague's older brother was working at Ubisoft on a game called Beyond Good & Evil. When Square dropped the trailer featuring that cinematic, there was dead silence in the studio the next day. Everyone was stunned by the sheer technical leap. Their game was due out at the end of the year. They ended up starting almost from scratch because the release of FFX had rendered two years of their work graphically obsolete. They weren't the only ones, either; some studios had to completely change their approach to game design. Final Fantasy X thus marked the beginning of the "graphics arms race... a trend that, unfortunately, led to a homogenization of design by the end of the 2000s.

It’s crazy to think just how unrivaled Square was in the early 2000s (to the point where even Disney tried to piggyback on their hype) and then to see how they managed to squander the gold mine they were sitting on. There’s a parallel universe where SquareSoft acquires Marvel in 2008 and Star Wars in 2013, and where the PlayStation 5 is called the "SquareStation 2" following a merger with Sony in 2006. Even though Square remains one of the biggest studios, it pales in comparison to what they could have become had it not been for a cascade of bad decisions. Any other company would have gone under long ago. In that sense, the existence of the FFVII Remake trilogy is nothing short of a miracle...

stories.text: I kinda associate this song with the last points of my life I was still positive of my future, which was January of 2018. I had saved up enough money to buy this game on PS4. But then things in my personal life went very awry, like not even a month later, and kinda started a continuous struggle with depression. Keep in mind i was only like 13, but in a weird way, this song now seems like the last song of my childhood innocence, in a way. I’ve had to deal with a lot of shit since I’ve been born, but I still had a sense of optimism. It’s crazy how music can be intrinsically tied with emotional moments of your life, but that’s the power of music, wether it’s good or bad, it can bring us back in time to moments that can forever change how you are and what that can lead to.

stories.text:
Tidus: Who are you, anyway? You knew my old man, didn’t you?
Auron: Yeah.
Tidus: And you also knew Yuna’s father?
Auron: That’s correct.
Tidus: Hey, man, there’s no way. That’s just impossible.
Auron: Nothing impossible about it. Jecht, Braska and I… Together we defeated Sin ten years ago. Then I went to Zanarkand… where I watched over you. So that one day I could bring you to Spira.

Auron: Jecht asked me to.

stories.author: @FiendMatadorSlayerOfNoobs
stories.text:
Man, oh man. I was 10 years old when I got to this, on a snowy, lit up December in 2001- My cousin had bought a PS2 and 3 games: Wrath of Cortex, Sons of Liberty, and Final Fantasy X.

I was a scrawny little kid from a non-English speaking country, who pieced together what little my brain could just from context, events and associating certain phrases & words, and my really badly-managed Sphere Grid..


But dang, this music made me bawl from how beautiful it was. My father legit thought I had hurt myself while playing. I still remember how he had this small laugh before he gave me a big hug during the violin part and asked me if the "movie" was sad.

Heh, he was awestruck when I told him it was a video game. After that, he would sit down and watch me play on occasion, and since he actually could speak an okay amount of English, he would translate stuff I didn't understand in the cutscenes. Shit, I love my childhood.

I remembered that when I started to figure Tidus's fate out I was like: no, no, no no no no NO! COME ON! It broke my heart. How I wish this story turned out in a book or a movie so I can treasure it forever.

SUTEKI DANE / RIKKI

【Verse 1】
Words the wind carried in,
my heart drifted along.
Voices leaping with hope
for tomorrow the clouds will bring.

In the moonlit mirror,
my trembling heart sways.
As the stars fall away,
soft tears spill down my face.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’ll lay myself on your chest,
lose myself in the dusk,
and dream.

and words fade into gentle illusions.
The clouds break apart,
and tomorrow becomes a distant voice.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’d softly reach out
and touch your face,
melting into the morning,
and dream.

Words carried by the wind
set my heart adrift.

hidden within the evening,

dreaming.

The words become

a gentle illusion.

The clouds break apart.

Tomorrow

becomes a distant voice.

⸻

The mirror blurred by the moon

carries away my heart.

overflowing—

tears

I can no longer hide.

⸻

dreaming

stories.author: @museyip815
stories.text:
The “Ending Theme” of FINAL FANTASY X is absolutely stunning and beautiful. Whenever I listen to it and watch the wonderful scenes that it is forever associated with, I always find myself in tears. Several years ago, after my dad’s passing in 2014, my mom and I listened to this track together for the first time. We were very moved by it. Listening to it somehow helped us to heal together after the tragedy that we had endured. Therefore, the “Ending Theme” always made, and continues to cause, me to think of him. So many great memories came back to me during the ensuing years. After my mom later passed away due to cancer in October of 2023, listening to the “Ending Theme” allowed me to begin to heal while thinking of them. My parents were my first best friends and my caregivers during their lifetimes. I am a wheelchair user who has a cerebral palsy diagnosis. To this day, it brings back memories of them whenever I listen to the “Ending Theme”. Their smiles; their laughter; their love; their wisdom; their joy; and much more are among those memories. Today (January 19th of 2026) marks more than 2 years since my mom’s passing. There is not a day that goes by without letting me think of her and my dad. My journey, ever since their departures from this world, has been very difficult. But, somehow, I find the courage to continue to do my best to keep their legacy alive and to live a fulfilling life in their memory. Even though “the journey will be hard”,  which  is what Yuna says after the credits  in the English-language version of FINAL FANTASY X, I will be able to live such a life because of my parents’ memory; the love that they shared with me; and the kind-hearted people who are in my life. This is what I continue to hope for. I pray that my parents will continue to bless me and protect me from beyond. 

Hi, Mom. Hi, Dad. I  love you very much and I miss you every day. There’s not a day that goes by without listening to me speak about wanting you to come back to me. There’s not a day that goes by without letting me have courage as I think of you and try to do my best each day. Every beautiful memory I have of you is a blessing and a portal to wonderful dimensions. Thank you for everything that you have given, and continue to give, to me. Even though my journey has been, and will be, difficult, I promise to continue to do my best. I promise to never forget to smile. Love you, Mom. Love you, Dad. May you continue to be at peace now, forever, and always. You remain in my heart, and will continue to have sanctuaries in it. Please continue to guide, protect, and bless me by way of your love. I will see you again.❤🙏🏻

Yuna’s courage; Tidus’ reconciliation with Jecht; the love that Yuna and Tidus share; as well as the beautiful soundtrack of FINAL FANTASY X are among the many things that I will always remember about this game, even though I have never played it before. 

Blessings to everyone who made FINAL FANTASY X possible and to everyone who continues to preserve its  marvelous legacy. 

I send my love to all of you as someone who is trying to brighten my future while cherishing my memories and cherishing the goodness of each day that I experience. I am someone who is searching for my own Zanarkand. My own haven of dreams. I pray that I will find it someday. 

Best wishes from New York City, 
Muse Yip

stories.author: @しょっくん-w7x
stories.text:
SUTEKI DANE / RIKKI

【Verse 1】
Words the wind carried in,
my heart drifted along.
Voices leaping with hope
for tomorrow the clouds will bring.

In the moonlit mirror,
my trembling heart sways.
As the stars fall away,
soft tears spill down my face.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’ll lay myself on your chest,
lose myself in the dusk,
and dream.


【Verse 2】
The wind falls still,
and words fade into gentle illusions.
The clouds break apart,
and tomorrow becomes a distant voice.

My heart drifts through
a mirror blurred by the moon.
As the stars tremble,
tears I can’t hide spill over.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’d softly reach out
and touch your face,
melting into the morning,
and dream.
